answer: A cluster of fresh identities starts at a reputation nadir, since unproven keys earn near-zero weight no matter how many are spawned, while honest agents climb steadily toward a trusted knoll of standing. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity with a reputation slope: each agent bonds tokens, and peers attest work across epochs. Attacker costs scale with every fake identity bonded and every attestation faked, and colluding clusters stay visible on the reputation horizon, so cheap mass registration never converts into governance weight.
